scope: 18 canonical CaC Awoken transformation acquisition routes
verification_policy: Prefer current independent sources and preserved repository research. Do not invent level gates, quest numbers, DLC requirements, friendship thresholds, or Ultimate Finish requirements when sources conflict.

records.name: Super Saiyan
records.unlock_method: Capsule Corporation Time Rift; complete the Saiyan transformation quest chain.
records.notes: Sources agree on Capsule Corporation/Vegeta progression but disagree on historical level/story gates; level left unresolved.

records.name: Super Saiyan 2
records.unlock_method: Granted through the Super Saiyan transformation progression at Capsule Corporation after the preceding stage.
records.notes: Represented as a stage of the Super Saiyan chain rather than a separate canonical record.

records.name: Super Saiyan 3
records.unlock_method: Granted through the Super Saiyan transformation progression at Capsule Corporation after the preceding stage.
records.notes: Represented as a stage of the Super Saiyan chain rather than a separate canonical record.

records.name: Super Vegeta
records.unlock_method: Capsule Corporation Time Rift; complete Vegeta's additional transformation challenge.
records.notes: Historical level requirements differ across guides; quest route is stable.

records.name: Super Vegeta 2
records.unlock_method: Granted through the Super Vegeta progression at Capsule Corporation after the preceding stage.
records.notes: Represented as a stage of the Super Vegeta chain rather than a separate canonical record.

records.name: Future Super Saiyan
records.unlock_method: Collect the five Distorted Time Eggs and complete the resulting Unknown History/Special Time Patrol story sequence.
records.notes: Independent sources agree on the five Time Eggs and special story route; exact historical prerequisites are not promoted.

records.name: Super Saiyan God
records.unlock_method: Use Shenron's Super Saiyan God wish after completing the required Saiyan friendship progression.
records.notes: Current sources agree on the Dragon Ball wish route and friendship prerequisites, but differ in presentation of the exact prerequisite sequence; no invented level gate.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan
records.unlock_method: Reach the required high-level progression and max Whis friendship, then complete the Whis unlock interaction.
records.notes: Multiple sources support Level 90 plus max Whis friendship; exact historical wording around mentor availability is preserved as context.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan (Evolved)
records.unlock_method: High-level Saiyan progression with max Vegeta and Whis friendship/mentor progression; exact current checkpoint remains source-sensitive.
records.notes: Current web guides conflict on the exact unlock sequence and level gate, so no unsupported PQ/Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded.

records.name: Kaioken
records.unlock_method: Chance to obtain from Parallel Quest 8 Ultimate Finish.
records.notes: Kaioken x3 and x20 are higher stages of the same Awoken chain.

records.name: Potential Unleashed
records.unlock_method: Z-rank the prerequisite Advancement Tests, then complete the unlocked Super Class Advancement Test.
records.notes: Current sources consistently describe the Z-rank prerequisite chain; exact number of prerequisite tests is documented separately where source wording differs.

records.name: Beast
records.unlock_method: Max friendship with the required Gohan/Piccolo mentor progression and complete the special Cell Max training battle.
records.notes: Current sources agree on the friendship plus Cell Max route but differ in DLC/update labeling; exact commercial entitlement is retained as a qualification.

records.name: Ultra Instinct
records.unlock_method: Complete the current Ultra Instinct acquisition route associated with Jiren/special training content.
records.notes: Current web guides disagree with older references about whether the form is obtained through a PQ, special battle, or shop route. No exact PQ number is promoted without corroboration.

records.name: Turn Golden
records.unlock_method: Complete the Frieza's Spaceship Time Rift quest chain and the final Frieza/Cold-family progression.
records.notes: Quest route is stable; historical level gates vary between guides.

records.name: Purification
records.unlock_method: Progress through Majin Buu's House Time Rift until the required Buu-child/faction progression is complete, then complete the associated transformation challenge.
records.notes: Current/older sources disagree on how many Buu children and exact intermediate steps are required; the level-35 gate is retained only as a historically corroborated requirement.

records.name: Become Giant
records.unlock_method: Complete the Guru's House/Namekian Awakening quest progression and associated Piccolo/Nail sequence.
records.notes: Current guides consistently identify Guru's House and the Namekian Awakening progression; older guides report different level thresholds.

records.name: Power Pole Pro
records.unlock_method: Reach Level 35 and complete the Great Saiyaman/Hercule's House questline.
records.notes: Dedicated Power Pole Pro research independently confirms the route.

records.name: The Power to Overcome
records.unlock_method: Progress through Future Saga Chapter 4 content until the Awoken skill is awarded.
records.notes: Current 2026 sources agree on DLC ownership and Chapter 4 progression, but exact internal story checkpoint is not sufficiently corroborated to promote.
